In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper presents a PBF and information transfer scheme for multiuser MIMO systems aided by RISs.

the PBIT technique can be applied to the RIS aided multiuser MIMO systems to improve the system performance, and the proposed algorithms for P BF and information transfer are effective and efficient for the considered scheme.

the P BF and information transfer design for Mu MIMO systems with the aid RISs is a challenging problem, and our proposed P BF and receiver algorithms can be considered as a first step toward the practical implementation of such systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed the PBIT scheme for RIS aided Mu-MIMO system, and proposed a novel receiver structure for the considered PBIT scheme.

we have proposed a PBIT scheme for Mu MIMO systems where the RIS can enhance the primary communication and at the same transmit additional information by the reflecting state of each reflecting elements.
we develop an efficient Mu MIMO PBF design and receiver design for the RIS aided multiuser communication systems, which can be extended to the multi-RIS scenario with low complexity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RISs are capable of enhancing the primary communication via P BF while delivering information by the on/off reflecting modulation.
the P BF and receiver design can be performed in two separate modules, and the P BF design can be decoupled from the receiver design.
the RISs can serve as a passive communication relay and a passive information carrier, and hence can be exploited for both communication and information transfer.
